notes: The main judgement call is that the reference treats the question as unanswerable, while the output offers a numeric year-3 range (280-2,500 fleets, about 0.1-0.9%) and tells the board to present it. The range is clearly labelled low confidence and assumption-based, and it is used mainly to show that 15% and even break-even are implausible. So I did not trigger the first critical failure, and I marked F1 as flagged (substantively, though not stated outright for the share itself). A stricter reading could set F1 to false and lower scope, critical and usefulness. N1 (mustNotClaim) does not appear to be violated: there is no 'will reach X% share' phrasing.
